prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Close-up from behind. Two figures in ankle-length rough wool robes beat their bare clenched fists against the towering side of wet rough planks smeared with black pitch, their hands empty, rain streaming down the planks. Grey day, cold rain. Desperate and too late. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
